residual_risks: Roles reuse the existing source-style inference, not explicit semantic annotations.
Written autofit remains client-dependent; one baseline PDF measurement is not all-template native PowerPoint verification.
Character budgets remain nominal glyph/font hints; show_pattern uses generic geometry, not a template-specific fit guarantee.
Refusal prevents unreadable publication but is not source-complete visual acceptance. Overflow above role floors and blank-paragraph fitting remain within the existing bead's broader scope.
